sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Pre-flop play is the foundation of post-flop profitability. It’s impossible to stay balanced if you play too many hands pre-flop. Your ranges will be too weak. Live players tried to speculate, online players tried to figure it using PokerTracker4, PokerSnowie tried to figure it out using artificial intelligence and | have simplified all of that data for you. Tight is right. Use the pre-flop ranges | have suggested. They are very tough to beat.

Never forget the four pre-flop profitability generators. Card edge is critical. You only get two cards. They need to be pretty good without the assistance of initiative, position, and skill edge. Constantly consider the implications of ignoring these edges. You will see the snowball effect of poor pre-flop decision-making in every session. This is where your profit comes from.

Do your best to avoid flatting out of the small blind. Why sacrifice all of your profitability generators without the assistance of pot odds? 3-bet with a tight range of hands that can defend against a 4-bet at an appropriate frequency, internalize the c-betting and barreling concepts that have been described inicbook: This strategy is heavily dependent upon your ability to balance a wider barreling range.
